# Decompiled function and module index

The current Ghidra export has 2,171 function boundaries: 1,958 marked ok and 213 with warnings. The exhaustive table is analysis/decompiled_modules/function_catalog.csv. It lists address, current Ghidra name, size, warning status, direct callers/call sites, string references, documented role and confidence. An autogenerated FUN_address name or a generated C listing does not mean the routine is understood.

Supporting Ghidra outputs are in analysis/reference. Targeted menu work is in analysis/ghidra_scripts and the earlier workspace's integration_review/menu_flow artifacts. The current source modules are in firmware/source.

The decompilation export spans the application, but most functions remain unreviewed. RF/DSP interrupt flows, DMR slot and color-code accept/drop decisions, audio/recording, GNSS/APRS/roaming, settings persistence and CPS protocol need further work. Consult confidence column in the CSV before relying on a routine.

Note (2026-10-14): `analysis/ghidra_scripts/32b_data.fixed.sinc` fix 3 corrects `zext`/`sext`; 156 of 2171 functions now decompile differently (multi-bit bit fields were one bit short). Re-check decompiler-derived bit widths in older notes against the disassembly.

## Subsystem tags for unreviewed rows (2026-10-17)

898 of the 1669 unreviewed rows carry `subsystem = auto: <tag>` (still `unreviewed`): a lead from task reachability,
strings, I/O, RAM owners and call neighbours, 90.5 % agreement in a hand spot check (74 functions). Largest groups:
`shared (UI tasks)` 240, `Audio/vocoder` 173 (IRAM vocoder library), `Menu/input` 78, `Main loop` 57, `Baseband
registers` 54, `CPS/USB` 43, `UI/call display` 39, `shared (DMR tasks)` 33. Filter the catalog on `auto:` to navigate;
see [SUBSYSTEM_TAGS.md](SUBSYSTEM_TAGS.md) for the method and weak spots, and
`analysis/decompiled_modules/subsystem_tags.csv` for all tags with reasons.
